description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Category model in the Goteo application, testing creation, validation, language handling, relationships with Sdg, and deletion.

classes.name: CategoryTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing the Category model's functionality including creation, translation, relationships with SDGs, and deletion.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes language configuration before any tests are run.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of Category and verifies its type.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Checks validation and save behavior for an empty Category instance.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a valid Category instance, validates and saves it, then verifies data integrity.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Sets a translation language for the Category and verifies success.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Verifies translations are correctly stored and retrieved in different languages.

methods.name: testSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, replacing, and retrieving SDG relationships with Category.

methods.name: testRemoveSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests removing SDG relationships from the category.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes the Category instance and verifies deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Checks behavior when accessing or deleting a non-existent Category.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Performs cleanup of test data in the database after all tests.
